set_aside.subject: _classify_photo_replay and publish_progress_photo photo_date handling
set_aside.text: - _classify_photo_replay: [BEHAVIOR] MUST return existing only when the same intake_id publication content agrees: project_id, section_id, caption, client_visible, file_ref and photo_date are equal (intake_source is not persisted and is not compared); conflict raises PhotoConflictError without mutation, intake_id being the replay identity.
set_aside.other_text: - publish_progress_photo: [BEHAVIOR] MUST read the current UTC time once per operation, by one call of utc_now, and use that single instant for every timestamp it writes and every current-time comparison it makes; it MUST NOT read a host clock itself. A supplied `photo_date` that carries a UTC offset MUST be converted to UTC, keeping its instant, before it is stored offset-naive; a supplied offset-naive value is taken as UTC.
set_aside.question: Must replay comparison require literal equality between existing.photo_date and publication.photo_date, which makes an aware publication unequal to its stored offset-naive UTC form, or must _classify_photo_replay normalize publication.photo_date before comparing them?
set_aside.set_aside_because: an unchanged passage of a unit reviewed for its change
